acceptanceCriteria: Preregistered request set, target repo and kill threshold recorded before mining
Spike outcome measured against the preregistered criteria and recorded in a build-log entry with a go or kill recommendation for owner read-back
If go: an intent and numbered requirements drafted as an AMAP/AMSP amendment or a new spec for owner acceptance
body:
Owner goal 2026-10-18: know every page, page object, link, data setup and step in a site, gathered from its tests, so that 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates it with confidence.

Existing pieces (read-only inventory 2026-10-18, origin/main 6ceee260b):
- AMAP screen graph: three literal router dialects; React JSX Routes reads 0 screens (V1-1712).
- ANL edges.
- TestFile Gotos, Selectors and Methods: Playwright only.
- AFU flow intents: authored, not mined.
- AMSP `flows appmap plan --draft`: term match over declared flows; emits test.fixme with TODO assertions.
- CCE-V0 compiled e2e: killed after V1-1677 (0/10 useful), pivot V1-1733.

Gaps: no extraction of data setup (test.extend fixtures, beforeEach, storageState, page.route mocks, API seeding); no mining of existing tests into anchored step sequences; page-object resolution is shallow (V1-1236); no how-to query over mined tests; no run-to-prove path for a composed test.

Spike design (Playwright only, one real repo whose router AMAP resolves): mine each hosted test into anchored records: setup facts, ordered goto, page-object calls, fill and click actions, and the real assertions. Rank whole tests and their prefixes lexically against the request. Emit a runnable spec composed only of mined, anchored statements, with the source test's real assertions, abstaining with named UNKNOWNs otherwise. Run it through corvint-test/PWP and bind a receipt so the answer reads VERIFIED@REV. Confidence means a receipt at the revision, not model confidence; mined steps stay learned evidence under project authority (invariants 1-3, 8). Browser and Node stay in companions (invariant 7).

Preregistered measure: N owner-written 'how do I X' requests with known answers. Report: share answered vs abstained; composed tests passing at head and failing on a seeded mutant (CCE-V0-009); zero unanchored statements; byte-identical reruns. Kill if under 40% of requests are answered with a passing, discriminating test.
title: Spike: test-mined how-to knowledge: mine steps, page objects and data setup from hosted Playwright tests, compose and prove a how-to e2e
